claims: Roberto Sanchez is a Cuban-American actor, producer, and director.
Roberto Sanchez has appeared in over 130 film and television projects.
Roberto Sanchez is often credited as "Sanz".
Roberto Sanchez served in the U.S. Navy during the Gulf War.
Roberto Sanchez worked as a print model.
Roberto Sanchez was an armed officer for the Miami Metro System before his acting career.
Roberto Sanchez played Loco in BMF.
Roberto Sanchez played Pinky in Palm Royale.
Roberto Sanchez appeared in Running Point.
Roberto Sanchez appeared in 2 Fast 2 Furious.
Roberto Sanchez appeared in Queen of the South.
Roberto Sanchez appeared in Lake Los Angeles.
Roberto Sanchez was an Imagen Award nominee for Lake Los Angeles.
Roberto Sanchez wrote the feature film 72 Hours.
Roberto Sánchez Palomino is a Peruvian politician and congressman.
Roberto Sánchez Palomino served as Minister of Foreign Trade and Tourism.
Roberto Sánchez is a Spanish producer and musician specializing in roots reggae and dub.
